subject: Suggestion:  display package versions in shinyapps console

messages.author: aacdf4534922e52f
messages.subject: Suggestion:  display package versions in shinyapps console
parts:
I am newly experimenting with ShinyApps.  My goal is to allow rgl to be used.  I uploaded the "bivar" example from the shinyRGL package, but it fails with an rgl error.  To diagnose this, it is helpful to know which version of rgl it is using, but that seems to be a little trickier to obtain than it should be. 
(I had to modify the app to include the text from packageVersion("rgl") and upload the modified app.) 

Wouldn't it be better to display it as one of the tabs in the ShinyApps console?

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Suggestion: display package versions in shinyapps console
parts:
Duncan,

shinyapps.io uses whatever package version that your machine uses locally. You get the all the detected package dependancies (and their versions) by running:

shinyapps::appDependencies()

-Andy
